data.name: Codex-Named Unit (equipment_inner_sea_gods_isg_equip_lst_19)
data.description: This altar is an iron platform and frame designed to support a heavy suit of spiked armor and weapons, typically mounted in the shape of a massively imposing, 8-foot-tall warrior. Praying at the altar grants a +4 morale bonus on saves against fear effects, and any non-masterwork iron or steel weapon the worshiper wields is treated as if it were masterwork.
